report:
RESULTS.md written with all five configurations; run1 to run3 have measured numbers, run4 and run5 are marked "not measured".
Source: benchmarks/runs/run1.json, run2.json, run3.json (n=3 each). No run4.json or run5.json exists.
I did not fill run4 and run5 with the estimates from NOTES.md. They are guesses, not results, and a review table would show them as measured.
The estimates also look wrong against the data:
- run4 "10% below run2": run2 runs all layers on GPU (110.4 tok/s). run3 has the same 20-layer setting as run4 and drops from 125.7 to 40.2 tok/s (about 68% lower). So run4 would likely land far below 10% under run2.
- run5 "5% above run1 on tokens/s": f16 is a larger model than q4_k_m. q8_0 is already 12% slower than q4_k_m here (110.4 vs 125.7), so f16 is unlikely to be faster.
To complete the table: finish run4 and run5, or have Dana add the estimates herself with an "estimate" label.
